patch.baseline: Preserved source snapshot after patch53; no earlier patch rewritten

change.default: Off; unset, 0 and yes preserve private pipelines for the unknown factory variant and retain ordinary known-variant caching.
change.factoryTag: Internal default-None CompiledShader identity, assigned only to the fragment emitted by RunColorResolve.
change.pipelineIdentity: Distinct identity domain, exact post-binding-patch fragment SPIR-V and exact generated TCS/TES SPIR-V. Normal vertex variant, layout/state, sample configuration and device keys are retained.
change.resourceAdmission: RecompileResult.variantId remains zero for the factory fragment and generated stages. Resource, recipe and validation cache gates are unchanged.
change.collisionHandling: Existing exact byte-key equality remains mandatory; a hash mismatch/collision cannot reuse another compiled pipeline.
change.dynamicDescriptors: Current image address and extent metadata are excluded from immutable pipeline identity; descriptor ownership and updates remain per draw.

native.boundary: Vulkan object creation/destruction is counted by mocks; ShaderResources is an explicit immutable-layout adapter. No real GPU or resource build.
native.positiveShaderValidation: The original VS, production 2/4/8-sample resolve factory and patched binding variant pass production ValidateShaders and canonical rectangle provenance.
cases: identical actual factory and canonical rect tuple reuses one CachedPipeline
relocated source image address/width leaves same pipeline code and reuse
sample2/4/8 separation with actual ValidateShaders + canonical proof
patched image/fault binding separation with actual shader inspection
exact TCS and TES word mutation separation (cache-only negative controls)
unknown ordinary fragment and VS stay private
wrong stage, duplicate factory tag and nonrect state stay private (cache-policy controls)
all generated variant IDs stay zero
unowned LRU victim expires under bound pressure while held pipeline survives
cache removal retains caller-owned pipeline until its shared_ptr releases
cross-device and same-handle/new-buffer-pool identities do not reuse old objects
mock final Vulkan objects fully retired/destroyed
ordinary known variants still cache with the new option disabled

priorSourceNegativeControl.source: prior53 Pipeline.cpp with new header and identical fixture

validation.independentReadOnlyReview: No blocking issue found; preserved snapshots and executable/fixture/script/production/run-log hashes independently matched.

limits: No iPad/GPU execution or measured speed improvement for candidate54 is established here.
The native fixture tests actual cache and mock Vulkan lifetimes with a layout boundary adapter, not full ShaderResources or Recorder fence behavior.
Altered header words and invalid stage/tag tuples test cache isolation directly; they do not claim production Draw accepts noncanonical or invalid geometry.
Production/source provenance refers to preserved patch54 snapshots; subsequent changes to ColorResolve.cpp do not establish current-source equivalence.
Runtime resource, alias, synchronization and visual qualification require separate device evidence.
